summary: Iteration 20 — validated all 3 new GCU365 CROMS integration features end-to-end: (1) hosted report links (public HTML + PDF + images with token, 404 on invalid), (2) inbound rental-events endpoint + open-rentals list & dismiss, (3) Developer Sandbox Playground UI (job submit → hosted report link + PDF, rental-events tester). Backend pytest: 17/17 pass. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request mentions the frontend route as '/trip-inspection' but App.js registers it as '/trip'. Not a bug — spec doc mismatch. If backwards-compat alias '/trip-inspection' is desired, add a redirect.

Playground pair pickers use slots [front, rear, left, right, roof, interior] (test-ids play-file-{before|after}-{slot}); spec example 'driver' is inaccurate but count is correct (6 slots × 2 = 12 file inputs).
